tools.charcount.description: Counts characters with and without spaces, plus words, sentences, manuscript pages, bytes, per-type breakdown and reading time — all on one screen.
tools.charcount.lead: With/without spaces · bytes · manuscript pages · reading time · limit checks
tools.jsonfmt.description: Formats, minifies and sorts JSON keys, walks it as a tree, and copies the path at any line you click.
tools.jsonfmt.lead: Format · tree view · copy path · error location · fix common mistakes
tools.hangulkey.description: Recovers text typed without switching the Korean/English key. Mixed text is judged piece by piece.
tools.hangulkey.lead: dkssud ↔ 안녕 · instant · mixed text handled per fragment
tools.qrgen.description: Builds QR codes for URLs, WiFi, contacts and plain text, drops a logo in the middle, and downloads as PNG or SVG.
tools.qrgen.lead: URL·WiFi·contact · logo overlay · reads its own QR back to verify
tools.lotto.description: Draws 6 numbers out of 1–45 at random. Run several games at once, pin numbers you always want, exclude numbers, and set an odd/even balance.
tools.lotto.lead: Up to 20 games · pinned numbers · exclusions · odd/even rules
tools.timer.description: A countdown timer and a stopwatch with laps. 1/3/25-minute presets, an end chime, and the remaining time in the tab title so you can watch it from another tab.
tools.datecalc.description: Days between two dates, the date N days from today, time left to a D-Day, and exact age — in one place. Weekday-only counts are shown alongside.
tools.datecalc.lead: D-Day · between two dates · weekdays only · 100-day and anniversary marks
tools.unitconv.description: Converts length, weight, area, volume, temperature, data, speed and time. Includes Korean units such as pyeong, geun and don, and shows the full conversion table for the same category.
tools.hashgen.description: Computes MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-3 and RIPEMD-160 of your text at once, and checks a downloaded file's checksum against the one the publisher listed. Files are never uploaded.
tools.hashgen.lead: MD5 · SHA-1 · SHA-256 · SHA-512 · file checksum match
tools.uuidgen.description: Generates as many UUID v4 and time-sortable v7 values, ULIDs, NanoIDs and random passwords as you need. Uses the browser's cryptographic randomness; nothing generated is sent anywhere.
tools.uuidgen.lead: UUID v4·v7 · ULID · NanoID · random passwords
tools.textdiff.description: Points out which lines differ between two texts, down to the characters that changed inside a line. Unified or side-by-side.
tools.textdiff.lead: Character-level inside lines · unified/side-by-side · compares as you paste
tools.regextest.description: Highlights matches as you type the pattern, and lists capture groups with their positions. Includes a replace preview and ready-made patterns for email, phone numbers and more.
tools.regextest.lead: Live matching · capture groups · replace preview · pattern presets
tools.colorconv.description: Converts between HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK, and computes the WCAG contrast ratio against white and black text to judge readability. Also builds complementary and triadic palettes and a brightness scale.
tools.colorconv.lead: HEX·RGB·HSL·CMYK · pick a color off the screen · contrast and palettes
tools.asciiart.description: Turns a photo or drawing into ASCII art. Adjust width in characters, character set, brightness, contrast and inversion, then save as text or PNG. Images stay inside your browser.
tools.asciiart.lead: Image → character art · 5 character sets · save as text or PNG
tools.specialchar.description: Arrows, stars, hearts, shapes, math symbols, units, brackets — characters that are hard to type, grouped by kind. Search by name and click to copy.
tools.specialchar.lead: Arrows · stars · shapes · math · units · brackets — click to copy
tools.ascii.description: A table of the 0–127 ASCII characters with their decimal, hex and binary values. Control characters such as NUL, LF and ESC come with what they mean.
tools.ascii.lead: 0–127 · decimal · hex · binary · what the control codes mean
tools.htmlentity.description: Entity codes for characters that are awkward to write directly in HTML —   < & © and the rest. Clicking copies the markup code, not the character.
tools.htmlentity.lead: · < · © — copies the code you put in markup
tools.httpstatus.description: HTTP response codes such as 200, 301, 403, 404, 429 and 500, with their names and a one-line note on when each is actually used. Search by number or by name.
tools.httpstatus.lead: 1xx–5xx · names · one line on when to use it
tools.colorname.description: All 148 CSS named colors with swatches and HEX values. Search by English name, Korean name or HEX.
tools.colorname.lead: 148 colors · name ↔ HEX · grouped by family
tools.keycode.description: Press a key and see event.key, event.code and keyCode straight away. Modifier state and a recent-key log are shown too, so you can check while building key handling.
tools.keycode.lead: Press and see · event.key · event.code · keyCode
tools.radix.description: Converts binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal on one screen. Edit one field and the rest follow, plus any base from 2 to 36 and the bit and byte counts.
tools.radix.lead: Binary·octal·decimal·hex at once · any base 2–36 · bit count
tools.textclean.description: Tidies multi-line text in one pass: sort, remove duplicate lines, clean up whitespace, add numbering. Chosen steps run in a fixed order and the original stays untouched.
tools.ladder.description: Write the players and the outcomes and it draws the ladder, then walks each name down its path to its match. The ladder is shown first and traced after, so you can watch the result happen.
tools.ladder.lead: Up to 10 players · watch the path · copy the result
tools.palette.description: Pulls the colors that represent a photo or drawing and shows them with HEX and RGB values. It divides the color space, so one large background does not take over the result.
tools.palette.lead: 4–64 colors · HEX · RGB · copy as CSS variables
tools.emoji.description: Find an emoji by searching in Korean, then click to copy. Grouped into faces, hands, hearts, objects, nature, food and symbols, and searchable by English name too.
tools.emoji.lead: Korean search · by category · click to copy
tools.markdown.description: Look up Markdown syntax — headings, tables, code blocks, checkboxes, collapsible sections — and copy it as is. Follows GitHub Flavored Markdown; every entry is a snippet you can paste straight in.
tools.markdown.lead: GFM · paste-ready snippets · search by category
tools.percent.description: Works out what percent of a total something is, what a given percent comes to, and how much a value changed — you fill numbers into a plain question. Discounts and rates of change share the screen.
tools.percent.lead: Discount · change rate · ratio · recover the original value
tools.interest.description: Maturity payouts for savings and deposits, and monthly payments on a loan. Savings account for each installment earning over a different span; deposits and savings include the 15.4% interest tax.
tools.urlparse.description: Turns percent-mangled addresses back into readable text, encodes them again, and lays out query parameters one by one. You can also strip only the ad-tracking parameters.
tools.urlparse.lead: Encode · decode · break out parameters · remove trackers
tools.gitcmd.description: Find the git command by what you are trying to do. Organized by situation rather than by command name, with the irreversible ones grouped and marked.
tools.gitcmd.lead: Search by situation · dangerous commands flagged · click to copy
tools.filetype.description: A table of what a file extension is and what opens it. Split into images, documents, archives, video, code, executables and more.
tools.filetype.lead: What is this file · what opens it · by category
tools.shortcut.description: Keyboard shortcuts for Windows, macOS, browsers and VS Code — only the ones you actually end up using. Search by what you want to do.
tools.shortcut.lead: Windows · macOS · browser · VS Code · Korean input
tools.caseconv.description: Converts between camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case and CONSTANT_CASE. Whatever you write it in, it splits into words on its own, and it handles many lines at once.
tools.jwt.description: Paste a JWT and it unpacks the header and payload, then works out the expiry time and how long is left. Standard claims come with what they mean.
tools.cron.description: Reads a cron expression back to you as a sentence and computes the next five times it will actually run. Common expressions can be dropped in with a click.
tools.cron.lead: Plain-language reading · next 5 runs · common examples
tools.worldclock.description: Current time in major cities worldwide alongside the offset from your reference city. Daylight saving and its switch dates are applied automatically, so it stays right across seasons.
tools.bmi.description: Computes BMI from height and weight and shows the Korean obesity-society bands next to the WHO international ones. The weight range that lands in the normal band is calculated too.
tools.bmi.lead: Two standards side by side · normal weight range · standard weight
tools.morse.description: Turns letters into Morse code and reads dots and dashes back into letters. Korean Morse is supported, and you can play it back as sound or as a blinking light.
tools.morse.lead: Both directions · Korean Morse · sound and light playback
tools.pick.description: Put in a list and draw at random, split it into teams, or set an order. Nobody is drawn twice, and team sizes never differ by more than one.
tools.pick.lead: Draw · split into teams · set an order
tools.charmap.description: Special characters, emoji, HTML entities and ASCII codes gathered into one set of tabs — find and click to copy. Each table is searchable by name and category.
tools.charmap.lead: Special characters · emoji · HTML entities · ASCII
tools.color.description: Three things in one place: convert color codes, pull the representative colors out of an image, and look up the standard CSS color names.
tools.color.lead: HEX·RGB·HSL · extract from an image · CSS color names
tools.text.description: Character counting, line-level tidying, comparing two texts, case conversion and Korean/English key recovery, gathered as tabs on one screen — the things you do one after another while working on a piece of writing.
tools.text.lead: Count · tidy · compare · case · Korean-English key
tools.reference.description: A reference sheet with git commands, Markdown syntax, HTTP status codes, shortcuts, file extensions and keyboard event codes as tabs in a single widget.
tools.reference.lead: git · Markdown · HTTP · shortcuts · extensions · key codes
tools.calc.description: Percentages, savings and loan interest, BMI, unit conversion and base conversion, gathered as tabs on one screen.
tools.calc.lead: Percent · interest · BMI · units · number bases
tools.time.description: Days between dates and D-Days, a countdown timer and stopwatch, and world city offsets, gathered as tabs on one screen.
tools.draw.description: Lottery numbers, ghost-leg ladders, name draws and team splits, gathered as tabs on one screen. All of them pick fairly at random.
tools.devtool.description: JSON formatting, JWT decoding, regex testing, hashing, UUID generation, reading cron expressions, URL breakdown and encryption, gathered as tabs on one screen.
tools.devtool.lead: JSON · JWT · regex · hash · UUID · cron · URL · crypto
tools.epoch.description: Converts between Unix timestamps and human-readable time. It reads the digit count to tell the unit — 10 digits means seconds, 13 means milliseconds.
tools.epoch.lead: Seconds/milliseconds detected · ISO · UTC · relative to now
tools.base64.description: Converts text to Base64 and back. Handles UTF-8 so non-Latin text survives, and supports the URL-safe form used in addresses and tokens.
tools.lorem.description: Generates placeholder text for mockups. Choose Korean filler or Lorem Ipsum, and set the count in paragraphs, sentences or words.
tools.csvjson.description: Converts between a CSV table and an array of JSON objects. Commas and line breaks inside quotes are handled by the rules, so columns never slip.
tools.csvjson.lead: Both directions · pick the delimiter · numbers detected
tools.regexref.description: A table of regex symbols and ready-made patterns. Look things up by what you are trying to do rather than by symbol name, and paste them straight in.
tools.regexref.lead: Symbols · quantifiers · anchors · full patterns · common snags
tools.numword.description: Reads a number out in Korean words and turns Korean number words back into digits. It also builds the formal amount wording used on contracts and receipts.
tools.numword.lead: Read in Korean · back to digits · formal amount wording
tools.aspect.description: Works out sizes while keeping the aspect ratio. Set one side and it fills in the other, and it lists common screen ratios and the letterbox margins.
tools.aspect.lead: Ratio-locked sizes · screen ratio list · margin calculation
tools.birth.description: One birth date gives you exact age, year age and Korean counted age, your zodiac animal, star sign and birthstone, the weekday you were born, and the countdown to your next birthday.
tools.birth.lead: Three age counts · zodiac·star sign·birthstone · next birthday D-day
tools.contrast.description: Computes the contrast ratio between text and background color and tells you whether it passes the web accessibility standard (WCAG). If it fails, it suggests the nearest color that passes.
tools.contrast.lead: Contrast ratio · accessibility verdict · a passing color suggested
tools.timecalc.description: Adds and subtracts time from a clock time, and sums several durations. Base 60 is easy to get wrong by hand or on an ordinary calculator; this gets it right.
tools.timecalc.lead: Add/subtract clock time · total hours worked · decimal hours
tools.replace.description: Find and replace in text. Before you commit, it shows how many places match and where they change, and you can undo afterwards.
